title: Two-step matrix bound and the global half-constant through n=4
statement: For every n-dimensional unit-diagonal SPD A with spectral floor mu, the exact without-replacement two-update decrease matrix satisfies K(A)>=J2(A)>=(2mu/n)A^{-1}. Consequently K(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1} for every n<=4.
assumptions: Uniform sampling without replacement for the first two coordinate updates
mu is the minimum eigenvalue of A
open_objections: For n>4 the coefficient 2/n is below 1/2, so this argument alone misses the target by a factor proportional to n.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
